name: UGC App Reveal
input_delivery: Keep prompt markdown unchanged; supply run_context and binding objects as separate JSON. Tokens name inputs and are not executable expressions.

binding_contract.hash_basis: SHA-256 of exact UTF-8 text, without normalization
binding_contract.uri_policy: Optional portable path resolved within the recipient release workspace; no author-local prerequisite
binding_contract.authority: Binding consistency grants no reviewer or execution authority

app_brief.description: Approved visible UI copy, layout, interactions, vision context and exact CTA.

approved_scope.description: Actual human instructions and decision references for unchanged work and authorized revisions; descriptive evidence only.

assembly_plan.description: Exact input versions, source intervals, frames, positions and authoritative editor.

asset_inventory.description: Available media, source intervals, acceptance scope and provider/source lineage; media and runtime IDs stay in the release workspace.

audio_plan.description: Whole-film dialogue, ambience, music, SFX and captions, each explicitly on or off.

brand_voice.description: Current brand tokens, voice examples and expression constraints.

caption_sources.description: Selected audible dialogue sources only, with hashes, trim offsets and locked transcript.

cast_references.description: Named identity/voice/wardrobe/setting roles and approved reference bindings.

dialogue_timing.description: Measured phrase windows tied to exact speech bytes, retained trim and film offsets.

event_map.description: Final UI/audio events with stable IDs and source/timeline times.

evidence.description: Technical/visual/listening/export receipts for exact artifacts; unavailable checks stay not_tested.

listing_manifest.description: Verified listing/card/photo source records and image hashes, or explicit not-applicable reason.

provider_plan.description: Recipient-owned route, current capability/cost evidence, budget and retry limits; no credential values.

review_findings.description: Current scoped feedback or explicit no-open-revision state; no invented acceptance.

review_schedule.description: Per-generation default or the actual named-film continuous-pass instruction, with pending gates.

run_context.description: Request/campaign identity, product, deliverable scope, format and audience/goal/CTA brief; no credentials.

shot_request.description: One requested performance, exact speech span, action, camera and edit/source duration.

source_facts.description: Selected product evidence and exact claim boundaries.

story.description: Exact angle, spoken/visual script and sketch, with their own source versions and hashes.

template_source.description: Inspected source URL/revision/entry/license, reused components and approved adaptations.

format_policy.source_enhancement: Optional separately authorized actor-picture operation; preserve accepted audio and source offsets

review_policy.continuous_pass: Requires explicit instruction for the exact named-film scope; unviewed takes remain pending assembled human review
review_policy.production_job_v1: Existing checker still models per-generation review; no fabricated acceptance event may bridge that limitation
review_policy.approved_export: Keep human decision and destination-copy verification bound to exact export bytes

evidence_boundary: Original reusable prompts from one approved production run. This index does not install a provider, run media jobs, authenticate approval or create an n8n runtime.
